```{r setup, include=FALSE}

require("knitr")
library(doParallel)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = T, eval = T, message = F, warning = F)
source(here::here("R/functions.R"), echo = F)

```

We used monthly environmental data to make predictions from the SDM. This script obtains monthly data from the CMS oceanographic models, calculates derived values as needed and creates standardized rasters for each prediction month, where each raster contains a layer for each predictor on the same grid.

# Get prediction colonies and dates

Generate a list of the colonies and dates of interest for prediction.

```{r sim-data}

colgrid <- readRDS(paste0(envir,'/colonies.RDS'))

my_dates <- c()

for (y in 2014:2023) {
  my_dates <- c(my_dates, seq.Date(as.Date(paste0(y,'-06-01 00:00')), as.Date(paste0(y, '-09-30 00:00')), by = '1 month'))
}

my_dates <- as.Date(my_dates)

```

Get grid extent to use in data downloads.

```{r my-grid}

r <- terra::rast(paste0(envir,'/colonydist/Baccalieu.nc'))
r <- rast_res(r, envir_res, focalNA = T)
r <- terra::ifel(r > 0, 1, NA)
terra::plot(r)
my_ext <- terra::ext(r)

```

### Get CMS data layers

Download monthly data for CMS physical oceanography data layers.

```{r cms-phys}
for (v in c('thetao', 'so', 'zos', 'mlotst','uo','vo')) {
  
  PelagicMagic::get_cms_data(
    my_env = cm_env,
    out_dir = paste0(envir, '/cms'),
    var = v,
    prod = "cmems_mod_glo_phy_hindcast",
    freq = c("monthly"),
    region = terra::ext(r),
    date_min = as.Date(min(my_dates)),
    date_max = as.Date(max(my_dates)),
    depth_min = 0,
    depth_max = 1,
    overwrite = FALSE
  )
}

r <- terra::rast(list.files(paste0(envir, '/cms/monthly/thetao'), full.names = T))
terra::plot(r[[1]])

```

Get mean SSH (mdt) if needed. Should already have this.

PelagicMagic::get_cms_data(

Get lower trophic level mesoplankton layers. These layers are only available in a daily format so we will create our own monthly averages.

```{r cms-ltml}

for (v in c('zooc','mnkc_epi','mnkc_hmlmeso','mnkc_mumeso')) {
  for (y in sort(unique(strftime(my_dates, '%Y')))) {
    fn <- list.files(paste0(envir, '/cms/daily/',v), full.names = T)
    if (length(grep(y, fn)) == 0) {
      
      PelagicMagic::get_cms_data(
        my_env = cm_env,
        out_dir = paste0(envir, '/cms'),
        var = v,
        prod = "cmems_mod_glo_ltml_hindcast",
        freq = c("daily"),
        region = my_ext,
        date_min = as.Date(paste0(y, '-01-01')), #as.Date(min(dat$timestamp)),
        date_max = as.Date(paste0(y, '-12-31')),#as.Date(max(dat$timestamp)),
        depth_min = 0,
        depth_max = 1,
        overwrite = FALSE
      )
      fn <- list.files(paste0(envir, '/cms/daily/',v), full.names = T, pattern = paste0(v, '.nc'))
      nn <- sub('.nc', paste0('-',y, '.nc'), fn)
      file.rename(fn, nn)
      
      # This is a hack to deal with NA problems that appear in some versions of terra
      r <- terra::rast(nn)
      rn <- terra::ifel(is.na(r), NA, r)
      terra::units(rn) <- terra::units(r)
      terra::varnames(rn)<- terra::varnames(r)
      terra::longnames(rn) <- terra::longnames(r)
      terra::time(rn) <- terra::time(r)
      r <- terra::rast()
      terra::writeCDF(rn, nn, unit = terra::units(rn), 
                      varname = terra::varnames(rn), 
                      longname = terra::longnames(rn),
                      missval = NA,
                      overwrite = T)
      
      
      print(paste('Finished:', v, y))
    }
  }
}

# Make monthly layers from daily data
for (v in c('zooc','mnkc_epi','mnkc_hmlmeso','mnkc_mumeso','zeu')) {
  fn <- list.files(paste0(envir, '/cms/daily/', v), full.names = T)
  for (f in fn) {
    of <- gsub('daily','monthly',f)
    if (dir.exists(dirname(of)) == FALSE) dir.create(dirname(of), recursive = T)
    
    if (file.exists(of) == FALSE) {
      r <- terra::rast(f)
      didx <- strftime(terra::time(r), '%Y-%m')
      rm <- terra::tapp(r, index = didx, fun = 'mean', na.rm = T)
      terra::time(rm) <- as.Date(paste0(unique(didx), '-01'))
      terra::writeCDF(rm, of, 
                      zname = 'time',
                      unit = terra::units(r)[1], 
                      varname = terra::varnames(r)[1], 
                      longname = terra::longnames(r)[1],
                      missval = NA,
                      overwrite = T)
    }
    
  }
}

r <- terra::rast(list.files(paste0(envir, '/cms/monthly/zooc'), full.names = T))
terra::plot(r[[1]])

```

## Get dervied current and gradient layers

Calculate any derived layers for physical oceanography:

- SSTSD
- SSHSD
- current
- currentsd
- SSHa

```{r}

dd <- sort(unique(as.Date(my_dates)))
fn <- list.files(paste0(envir, '/cms/monthly/thetao'), full.names = T)

calc_gradient_rast(layers =  fn,
                   dates = as.Date(my_dates), 
                   destination = paste0(envir, '/cms/monthly/sstsd'), 
                   newlabel = 'sstsd', 
                   w = 3, 
                   fun = 'sd', 
                   na.rm = T)

fn <- list.files(paste0(envir, '/cms/monthly/sstsd'), full.names = T)
r <- terra::rast(fn)
terra::plot(r[[1]])

# ----

fn <- list.files(paste0(envir, '/cms/monthly/zos'), full.names = T)
calc_gradient_rast(layers = fn, 
                   dates = as.Date(my_dates), 
                   destination = paste0(envir, '/cms/monthly/sshsd'), 
                   newlabel = 'sshsd', 
                   w = 3, 
                   fun = 'sd', 
                   na.rm = T)

fn <- list.files(paste0(envir, '/cms/monthly/sshsd'), full.names = T)
r <- terra::rast(fn)
terra::plot(r[[1]])

# -----

if (dir.exists(paste0(envir, '/cms/monthly/current')) == FALSE) dir.create(paste0(envir, '/cms/monthly/current'))

if (file.exists(paste0(envir, '/cms/monthly/current/current.nc')) == FALSE) {
  uo <- terra::rast(list.files(paste0(envir, '/cms/monthly/uo'), full.names = T))
  vo <- terra::rast(list.files(paste0(envir, '/cms/monthly/vo'), full.names = T))
  cv <- sqrt(uo^2 + vo^2)
  terra::writeCDF(cv, paste0(envir, '/cms/monthly/current/current.nc'), longname="Current velocity (m/s)", varname='current velocity',unit = 'm/s')
}

fn <- paste0(envir, '/cms/monthly/current/current.nc')
calc_gradient_rast(layers = fn, 
                   dates = as.Date(my_dates), 
                   destination = paste0(envir, '/cms/monthly/currsd'), 
                   newlabel = 'currsd', 
                   w = 3, 
                   fun = 'sd', 
                   na.rm = T)

fn <- list.files(paste0(envir, '/cms/monthly/currsd'), full.names = T)
r <- terra::rast(fn)
terra::plot(r[[1]])

# ----

if (dir.exists(paste0(envir, '/cms/monthly/ssha')) == FALSE) dir.create(paste0(envir, '/cms/monthly/ssha'))

if (file.exists(paste0(envir, '/cms/monthly/ssha/ssha.nc')) == FALSE) {
  ssh <- terra::rast(list.files(paste0(envir, '/cms/monthly/zos'), full.names = T))
  mdt <- terra::rast(list.files(paste0(envir, '/cms/static/mdt'), full.names = T))
  ssha <- ssh - mdt
  terra::writeCDF(ssha, paste0(envir, '/cms/monthly/ssha/ssha.nc'), longname="Sea surface height anomaly (m)", varname='ssha',unit = 'm')
}

```

###  Create monthly rasters of dynamic variables

Create a raster with layers for each dynamic variable for each month to predict to.

```{r}
od <- paste0(paste0(envir, '/monthly_extraction'))
id <- paste0(envir,'/cms/monthly')

br <- terra::rast(paste0(envir, '/bathymetry.nc'))
vv <- c("chl","current","currsd","mlotst","mnkc_epi","mnkc_hmlmeso",
             "mnkc_mumeso","nppv","so","ssha","sshsd","sstsd","thetao",  
             "zooc","zos")

make_dyn_rasters(dates = my_dates, in_dir = id, out_dir = od, base_rast = br, vars = vv) 

```

### Generate long-term means 

Create long-term means for Jun-Sep based on the 10 year averages in the monthly layers.

```{r}

input <- paste0(paste0(envir, '/monthly_extraction'))
od <- paste0(paste0(envir, '/ltm_extraction'))
if (!dir.exists(od)) dir.create(od)

mgrid <- data.frame(
  mn = c('0601','0701','0801','0901'),
  mb = month.abb[6:9]
)

for (i in 1:nrow(mgrid)) {
  
  fn <- list.files(input, full.names = T, pattern = mgrid$mn[i])
  out_file <- paste0(od,'/ltm_', mgrid$mb[i],'.nc')
  
  if (!file.exists(out_file)) {
    
    r <- terra::sprc(fn)
    r <- terra::mosaic(r, fun = 'mean')

    terra::writeCDF(r, out_file, missval = NA, split=TRUE,
                    overwrite = T)
  }
  
}

```
